scope: Bounded hypothesis-text packaging, exact frozen pre-cut inputs and reconstruction of the actual v4 public evidence. No model, network or game action.
selection_policy: Latest at most2 assistant messages containing nonempty string content/reasoning_content; newest gets up to8000 characters, total12000; overlong fields retain exact indexed head/tail; content precedes reasoning_content within a message. Tool arguments never read.
